I changed `totalPaidCents` in `src/services/order-service.js` so it leaves out orders from soft-deleted users. It's still callback-style: it first looks up users with `deleted_at === null`, then adds up paid, non-deleted orders whose `user_id` belongs to one of those users. I didn't run the tests.

Two things to know before you run them:

- **One existing test will now fail.** `tests/order-service.test.js:17` expects `4200 + 9900 + 500`. The 500 is order 13, which belongs to Alan (user 3), and Alan is soft-deleted in the seed data. The new total is `4200 + 9900` (14100). I didn't edit the test because you only asked about the service, but it needs that one-line change.
- **The repository version still includes those orders.** `src/repositories/order-repository.js:13` has the same paid-total query that Chapter 5 migrates to, and it still counts orders from soft-deleted users. Tell me if you want it changed the same way.
